race.comment: MISSION TAICHI (8) was a tough watch last start after being heavily-backed; held up at a crucial stage when the race was hotting up before charging late to just miss in a three-way photo. If there is a positive out of that run, it is that he'll be better for the run at 2000m and this looks an easier race. HARRY CAVIAR (4) is third up today. Turned in a better run last time when second, beaten 2.5 lengths, at Echuca over 1600m. Settles back early but winds up late. Watch for a big run. SHEZOUS (11) is drawn out but strikes the most suitable race she's been in to date and looks suited at 2000m. MEKA VIBE (7) has been racing consistently, including a last-start third over 1400m at Wodonga last weekend. Backing up is a positive and draws well with a claim.
